title: Search bias, baselines and robustness

objectives.text: Explain why optimizing a noisy validation score selects noise,and evaluate a frozen choice against later held-out/baseline evidence under matched assumptions.
Compute a bounded exact one-sided fair-sign null p-value and fixed-family Bonferroni adjustment,stating marginal null validity,trial-family and dependence/market limits.

blocks.markdown: Searching thresholds,features,seeds,universes,dates,execution/cost assumptions and stopping times can fit noise even when the final model has few parameters. Reporting only the best score hides the search. Cawley/Talbotdocument that overfitting the selection criterion can materially bias evaluation. A validation score used to choose a candidate is a selection score,not independent performance evidence for the winner.

Own synthetic validation means:A5,B6,cash0bps. Choose Busing validation only,with deterministic lexical tie rule. Later holdout means:A-2,B-4,cash0. Report Bvalidation6and later-4alongside cash0,not a silent switch to the holdout winner cash. This one example illustrates a possible selection failure;it does not estimate how often failures happen or prove every selected model loses. A valid strategy can also underperform over a short holdout.

blocks.title: One impressive trial versus a declared family

steps.text: Under an explicitly iidfair-sign null,eight independent+1signs have one-sided tail probability1/256. The statistic counts positive signs;it ignores economic magnitudes and costs.
If this is one of a fixed family of20valid marginal tests,Bonferroni adjusted p=min(1,20/256)=5/64≈0.078125. At predeclared alpha0.05,the raw test rejects butthe adjusted family test does not.

Union bound:if each true-null test has P(p_i<=alpha/m)<=alpha/m,then probability of any false rejection<=sum(alpha/m)<=alpha. Tests need not be independent from each other,buttheir marginal p-values and the declared finite family must be valid. This does not repair invalid time-series sign assumptions or hidden/adaptive trials.

blocks.caption: Expected1/2565/64True False;B6-4;invalid fair-sign sample. Complete exact Fraction/binomial tail source,not estimated MonteCarlo p. Family size supplied by caller must match actual predefined comparisons;code cannot discover omitted trials,validate iidmarket signs or correct arbitrary adaptive experimentation. No ttest/Sharpe significance or real trading returns inferred.

blocks.markdown: A p-value is a null-tail probability for a specified statistic/protocol,not the probability the strategy is false or a guarantee a rejection will profit. The fair-sign model assumes independent signs,each equally likely positive/negative under the null,with no zeros here. Market returns may be dependent/asymmetric,net of costs and continuous magnitudes;converting them blindly to this toy p-value is unjustified. Failure to reject does not establish no effect,and significance does not establish economic relevance.

Compare against an appropriate no-trade/cash,passive or simple strategy baseline with matched universe,timing,exposure/currency,data,cost/financing and evaluation interval. A high gross return from leverage or omitted costs is not automatically excess skill. Predeclare economic metrics,drawdown/turnover/liquidity exposure and acceptable failure modes,then show tradeoff/sensitivity rather than only a winning Sharpe. Cash baseline return is0ONLYin this declared zero-interest synthetic example.

Perturb defensible assumptions within an a-priori grid:costs/delays,capacity,periods,universes and nearby parameter values. Report the whole surface and failure regions,including valid runs with poor outcomes. Repeated robustness exploration becomes more search;do not relabel only favorable perturbations as confirmation. Costs can alter path and lower fills can avoid losses,so empirical responses need interpretation rather than a universal monotonic slogan.

Nested evaluation fits/chooses the full procedure within each inner training/validation loop,and evaluates it on outer held-out data. sklearn's Irisexample explains the selection principle butuses shuffled classification folds;do NOTcopy that splitting into historical market forecasting. Use time/label-aware inner ANDouter boundaries and train-only preprocessing from the prior lesson. Nested evaluation estimates the tested procedure under its data assumptions,not tomorrow's regime or a cure for every hidden human research choice.

Independent transfer:enumerate all2^nsign sequences for small nand check the exact tail count/p-value superuniform property under the stated fair null. Compare raw and fixed-family adjustment at predeclared alpha,then explain why unrecorded/adaptive trials break the given accounting. Freeze a candidate before reading a separate holdout,compare a same-rules baseline,and publish failures as well as scores. No positive result is a professional/trading competence certificate.

Sources:[Cawley/Talbot2010original model-selection-bias paper page](http://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html),[sklearnnested selection principle,Irisnot market folds](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/auto_examples/model_selection/plot_nested_cross_validation_iris.html),[NISTBonferroni general inequality](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/prc/section4/prc473.htm). Fair-sign exact tail and fixed-family p-adjustment are derived here from binomial counting/union bound,not a new market inference method.

summary: Selection searches can overfit validation noise;freeze choices and report later matched-baseline evidence honestly. Exact toy fair-sign/Bonferroni arithmetic needs valid null marginals and a declared family,not hidden adaptive trials. Robustness/nested time-aware evaluation remain scoped,not future-profit guarantees.
